title: Sub-agent failures must not dump the provider catalog
description: A failed /agents run notified the raw provider error, including the fallback model table and a redacted bearer header. The toast should be the agent, the code, and one sentence.
acceptance_criteria: A failed sub-agent toast is one or two lines: agent, trace, error code, and a short message. It does not include fallback tables, request headers, or tokens.
close_reason: Failure toasts no longer include provider dumps.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Toast now keeps the status clause and drops the provider body. The captured 401 dump reduced from a multi-line catalog table to 'ap-openai API error (401)', with the bearer line, redaction regex, and fallback table removed. A fresh live run could not reproduce the 401 (the pinned role succeeded), so that specific body is proven by replaying the captured text through the same cut. A separate live failure rendered as one line: role_unavailable: role task is not available for agent scout.

title: Stop echoing the prompt above every turn
description: Live captures show an AGENT OUTPUT banner repeating the user prompt, then Pi's own user message repeating it again. One of the two must go. The banner is Acidbath's, so remove the append.
acceptance_criteria: A submitted prompt appears once in the transcript. No AGENT OUTPUT banner is painted above it. Existing banner unit tests are updated or removed with the banner.
close_reason: Prompt echo removed and verified live.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Fixed and verified live, 2026-10-09. before_agent_start no longer appends the AGENT OUTPUT entry, so Pi's own user message is the only copy of the prompt. Capture docs/evidence/harness-tui/quiet-no-banner.png shows the prompt once, then the reply pong, with no banner.

title: Prove the live sub-agent activity line
description: Run a named harness agent while a true-input session is open. Capture the activity rail while the child is running. Confirm the line names the agent and a task preview, and that it clears after the run.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot shows an agents line with name · task while a child is running, and a later capture or snapshot shows the line gone after the child finishes.
close_reason: Live sub-agent line appeared and cleared.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Live true-input proof, 2026-10-09. First attempt with the shipped task role failed before the rail could matter: the provider returned 401 on the role's model, and the error toast dumped the fallback table. Retried with PI_ACIDBATH_AGENTS_PATH pointing scout at the pinned role (ap-codex/gpt-5.6-sol), which is the model the session already uses. While running, the activity rail showed 'agents  scout · Read README.md and name the first heading. Take'. After the child finished, the line was gone and the result toast read '[scout scout-mv0jcx9m] The first heading is acidbath.' Evidence: docs/evidence/harness-tui/quiet-agents-live.png and quiet-agents-done.png. The shipped example registry was not modified.

title: Prove collapsed and expanded tool rows live
description: Drive a real Pi session with true-input. Submit a prompt that makes the model call a read or bash tool. Capture the collapsed row, then expand it and capture the opened detail. Close the session after.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot shows a one-line tool row with a mark, tool name, and target, and no kaomoji. A second capture shows the same row opened with indented detail. Session closed.
close_reason: Collapsed and expanded tool rows captured live.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Live true-input proof, 2026-10-09. Collapsed row rendered as '· read  doc README.md:1-20  22 lines' with no kaomoji and no expand label. Ctrl+O opened it: the same row gained '· open' and the file body rendered indented underneath, ending in Pi's '[130 more lines in file]'. Evidence: docs/evidence/harness-tui/quiet-tool-collapsed.png and quiet-tool-expanded.png.

title: Quieter TUI: one face, collapsed tools, live sub-agents
description: Continue the calmer TUI pass from session 82438862. Idle screen has no face and no welcome card. Tool rows are one collapsed line. The activity rail is the only face, and it shows live sub-agents.
acceptance_criteria: Settled screen has no face and no welcome quote. A tool row is collapsed by default and opens on demand. A running sub-agent appears on the activity rail as name · task and clears when it finishes. Evidence is a true-input screenshot plus a Beads comment.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Both child proofs closed. Settled screen, collapsed and expanded tool rows, and the live sub-agent line are captured under docs/evidence/harness-tui/. The quieter TUI changes are uncommitted on fix/harness-feature-hardening.

title: Harness: integration, ADRs, and live PR QA
description: Linear: MIGHT-500. Integrate the harness extension, write ADRs, and run Droid Control live PR verification.
acceptance_criteria: Package manifest loads harness as a separate extension; existing UI/compactor work preserved; Node 22/24 test, typecheck, visual, focused integration, secret scan, and diff checks pass; Droid Control verifies all six capabilities live; Beads and Linear children updated.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Harness glue committed on feat/harness-omp-capabilities; focused harness tests + typecheck + git diff --check all green under Node 22.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Live QA evidence (PR #16). Screenshot capture unavailable: needs the true-input backend plus a Wayland compositor, neither present here; verification captured as terminal transcripts instead. Live-verified per feature: agents (single run, 3-way parallel fan-out, 3s timeout abort, 4000-char truncation with omission marker, redaction of OpenAI/AWS/GitHub credentials a subagent read from a file), magic (input hook matched, hint injected into system prompt), recap (generated and persisted as an acidbath-recap entry), handoff (six sections generated, editor-cancel path), state restore (keyword removal and active role both survive restart). ~/.pi/agent/acidbath/ cleaned of test config. PR #16 open and mergeable, no CI checks configured on this repo.

title: Harness: OpenAI compaction for Codex sessions
description: Linear: MIGHT-495. Provider-gated custom session compaction for OpenAI Codex. Initial production path uses a dedicated OpenAI compactor role via modelRegistry.complete with native fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Gates on configured Codex/OpenAI policy and opt-in settings; uses full session_before_compact preparation; any failure returns undefined so Pi native compaction runs; no token/header/body logging; unit tests cover success, bypass, abort, fallback.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure Codex-compact core landed and harness glue now installs the gated session_before_compact hook with native fallback.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16): six credential families leaked through the compaction sanitizer (AWS, GitHub classic and fine-grained, Google, Slack, name=value assignments) — real disclosure given this path renders model-generated error text that can echo a header or config dump. The gate never opened for a real Codex user: provider was compared literally to 'openai-codex', but the configured provider is 'ap-codex' with no explicit openai-codex-responses api; a provider whose final path segment is codex now counts. Every failure path returned {} silently; each skip now notifies before falling back to native compaction. Prompt injection boundary applied. 85 -> 120 tests.

title: Harness: core agent and subagent substrate
description: Linear: MIGHT-499. Implement only the core agent/subagent substrate: profiles, discovery, bounded execution, cancellation, concurrency ceiling, streaming updates, and structured result envelopes. Exclude OMP delegation policy.
acceptance_criteria: subagent tool plus /agents list|run; isolated Pi SDK sessions; project-local profiles require trust confirmation; bounded concurrency; no nested fan-out unless profile enables it; unit, cancellation, cap, and Droid Control pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure agent substrate landed and harness glue now registers the bounded subagent tool plus /agents list|run.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16, branch fix/harness-feature-hardening): provider failures no longer report as successful empty runs — Pi lands a failed call as stopReason=error with empty content, which the runner previously read as a clean success. New pure extractRunResult promotes it to a real envelope; formatEnvelope prints the stable error code. Redaction widened to AWS/GitHub/Google/Slack/assignment shapes. Preflight, fan-out clamp, extraction, and error description extracted as pure functions. 112 -> 194 tests. Live: single run, 3-way parallel, 3s timeout abort, 4000-char truncation, redaction of credentials read from a file.

title: Acidbath: integrate OMP-inspired harness capabilities
description: Umbrella for OMP-inspired Acidbath harness work. Linear: MIGHT-493. Separate non-visual harness extension owns handoff, roles, agent core, magic words, recap, and Codex compaction. Acidbath keeps UI; existing bash-result compactor stays independent.
acceptance_criteria: All six capabilities ship in a separate harness extension; Acidbath UI ownership unchanged; tests, typecheck, visual, and Droid Control live PR verification pass; no credential logging.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Feature-by-feature hardening pass published as PR #16 (branch fix/harness-feature-hardening, 7 commits, +3422/-241 across 20 files). Each subsystem audited against its ADR, pure implementation, tests, and live Pi behavior. Six functional defects found at the Pi execution boundary where unit tests could not reach: provider failures reported as successful empty runs, swallowed malformed role config, two fence-masking defects, magic state outliving its turn, a compaction gate that never opened for real Codex users, and silent compaction failures. One injection class fixed across recap/handoff/compaction. Persisted-state validators tightened and dead isMagicState wired into real restore. Gates: 3119 tests across 12 suites, tsc --noEmit clean, git diff --check clean.

title: Harness: persistent session recap
description: Linear: MIGHT-494. Add /recap [focus] as a session-persistent, non-context custom entry generated through the recap model role.
acceptance_criteria: Recap survives resume/branch as a custom session entry not sent to the LLM by default; compacted history handled; empty/error/abort states do not append partial recaps; pure tests and Droid Control persistence pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure recap core landed and harness glue now appends acidbath-recap custom entries with an entry renderer.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16): the recap prompt interpolated untrusted session text directly beneath its own structural delimiters, so a transcript line reading 'Conversation so far:' was parsed as prompt framing. Transcript and focus are now fenced, labelled data-not-instructions, and delimiter-imitating lines are neutralized with a zero-width joiner. serializeRecapSource silently dropped whole leading blocks with no marker — a recap built from a truncated tail would summarise it as the whole session. Dropped entries now produce a counted marker that counts against the budget. truncateBlockBody now respects very small budgets. 106 -> 142 tests. Live: recap generated and persisted as an acidbath-recap entry.

title: Harness: exact-prose magic words
description: Linear: MIGHT-498. Add OMP-inspired magic words through a single registry and Pi input-transform pipeline. Match enabled words as standalone lowercase prose only.
acceptance_criteria: Registry is the single source; global and per-keyword switches work; table tests cover positive and blocked contexts; no mutation of the raw user-visible prompt; live TUI proves one match and one blocked false positive.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure magic.ts + tests landed (1061 pass). Glue /magic command, input transform, and Droid Control still remaining.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16): fence mask no longer leaks an unterminated ``` fence (matched nothing, so code contents were read as prose) and now recognizes ```~~~``` fences. Pending matches are reset in both input and agent_settled so an aborted turn cannot leak hints into a later prompt. Disabling the last enabled keyword now clears registry.enabled instead of reporting matching 'on' while nothing can match. 1068 -> 1087 tests. Live: input hook matched 'plan', before_agent_start injected the hint.

title: Harness: explicit model roles and fallback routing
description: Linear: MIGHT-496. Add a validated role registry and /role command for explicit user-selected routing. Support OMP-inspired aliases, thinking-level suffixes, role references, scoped-model preference, and ordered fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic parser/resolver tests cover exact, inherited, cyclic, unavailable, and fallback paths; no silent permission change; role clear restores prior state; live Droid Control verifies switch and fallback.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure roles.ts + tests landed (82 pass). Glue /role command and Droid Control still remaining.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16): OMP-inspired role UX shipped — interactive picker via ctx.ui.select, live model catalog showing context window/cost/reasoning/vision, direct provider/model[:thinking] selectors, guided /role add dialog, persisted /role next cycle, typo suggestions, and an 'unavailable' label in picker entries. Separately, a malformed user roles.json was being swallowed: it reverted to built-in defaults with no message, making edits look ignored; the parse failure is now retained and surfaced by /role list with its path and reason. 172 tests.

title: Harness: structured cross-session handoff
description: Linear: MIGHT-497. Implement /handoff [goal] in the harness extension. Build a bounded structured handoff, generate with an explicit model role, allow TUI review/edit, then create a child session and prefill the replacement editor. Never auto-submit.
acceptance_criteria: Handles compacted and uncompacted branches; cancellation leaves current session unchanged; replacement context used after newSession; pure tests and Droid Control pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure handoff core landed and harness glue now wires /handoff via current-model generation + child-session prefill.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Hardening pass (PR #16): same injection class as recap — both the goal argument and conversation text are untrusted and were interpolated beneath the prompt's delimiters; both now fenced and defused. Two truncation defects fixed: the marker could be lost when a trailing partial line was stripped (so a truncated handoff read as complete), and a non-positive or tiny maxChars returned the full 12-char marker, exceeding the budget. buildHandoffPrompt no longer throws on a missing goal. Child-session creation is wrapped so a failure reports a reason. 109 -> 138 tests. Live: all six sections generated; editor-cancel reports 'handoff cancelled'.
